cost_model.entry: the first 5-minute close strictly after observed_at_ms
cost_model.note: no slippage beyond the cost constant; a stop is assumed filled at its own level

chain_rules.rule: parse the vendor title into oi_change/oi_value/whale_long_profit/whale_oi_ratio
chain_rules.threshold: regex on `OI Rise x%, OI Value yM, Whale Long Profit z%, Whale/OI Ratio w%`

chain_rules.rule: symbol canonical and ASCII-identity, ingest_mode=live, both clocks and all four measurements present, direction in {rise,fall}
source venue resolves to binance.usdm / hyperliquid.perp / hyperliquid.xyz
idempotency: this source_key already produced a Case
oi_value_usd >= min_oi_value_usd
now - observed_at_ms <= max_age_ms
this underlying has no undecided Case
market_key present in the Runtime's published route catalogue
one frame per underlying per turn, newest observed_at wins
at most _MAX_FREEZES_PER_TURN Cases frozen per lane turn
a candle closed at or before observed_at_ms, within the gap tolerance
measurement_window_ms == the policy's window
oi_direction == rise
oi_change_bps >= min_oi_change_bps
whale_oi_ratio_bps > min_whale_oi_ratio_bps
whale_long_profit_bps > min_whale_long_profit_bps
pre_move_bps >= min_price_move_bps over a 1 h lookback
pre_move_bps <= max_price_move_bps
Signal TTL, clamped to the source deadline
market_key present in this Runtime's own route map
chain_rules.threshold: the discovered catalogue (paper => Binance demo listing)

chain_rules.rule: no other active execution on the same instrument
instrument and quote tick in cache after the subscription warm-up
no unexpected exposure; market/account/reconciliation clocks fresh
chain_rules.threshold: market 5 s; account 2x, reconciliation 3x the 5 s scan period

chain_rules.rule: day-start equity minus current equity < max_daily_loss_usd
open positions < max_positions; leverage <= max_leverage
risk budget = min(1% equity, 10 USD, 25 USD total - aggregate risk)
spread <= 30 bps; entry priced at ask x (1 + 25 bps)
quantity = risk / stop_fraction / price, clamped by leverage, floored to the increment
market BUY, reduce_only=False, deterministic client order id
reduce-only stop at avg_entry x (1 - stop_distance_bps)
no take-profit and no time-based exit; only the stop or an operator flatten closes

policy_replay_reconciliation.note: The lane fetches its bars in a narrow window around the trigger and this replay reads one contiguous per-symbol page; a difference is a provider revision or a bar the lane's own window did not contain, never a different rule.

baseline.definition: same symbol and venue, a uniformly random 5-minute close in the frame window with 4 h forward

binance_catalogues.definition: baseAsset of USDT-quoted, USDT-margined PERPETUAL or TRADIFI_PERPETUAL with status TRADING

runtime.catalogue_source: paper mode discovers instruments from BinanceEnvironment.DEMO, i.e. https://demo-fapi.binance.com; live mode would read https://fapi.binance.com
